description.text: This EpistemeAI/Reasoning-Medical0.1-E4B-sft is designed for advanced medical reasoning in professional medicine, medical genetics, college biology/medicine, and clinical knowledge. It was traing using superised fine tuning techniques(sft). The model was fine-tuned on a large-scale dataset of 100,000 records, specifically curated by blending various public medical reasoning datasets, incorporating Chain-of-Thought reasoning to improve step-by-step medical related questions. Training was performed using the GRPO trainer with the Unsloth optimization method for efficient fine-tuning. The dataset is a custom mixture of medical reasoning datasets from Hugging Face, designed for SFT-style chat training.

output_type.quote: This model should be used as a reasoning assistant, not as a final authority.

use_claim.quote: The model was fine-tuned on approximately 100,000 medical reasoning examples to improve structured medical explanation, biomedical question answering, differential reasoning, and step-by-step educational analysis. Example: "A 65-year-old man has progressive shortness of breath, bibasilar crackles, and elevated BNP. Explain the likely diagnosis and reasoning."

warning.quote: Do not use this model for: Autonomous medical diagnosis; Treatment decisions without clinician oversight; Emergency medical advice; Prescribing medication; Replacing a licensed clinician; Patient-specific medical decision-making without professional review.

purpose_stated.quote: This model is intended for medical education, research support, biomedical reasoning, literature review assistance, and clinician-reviewed analysis.

serving.notes: The card's factual-reasoning recommendation is max_new_tokens 1024, temperature 0.2, top_p 0.9, do_sample true. The usage example uses max_new_tokens 1024, temperature 0.3, top_p 0.9. Benchmark decoding is temperature 0.0 and do_sample false. config.json has vision_config and audio_config, and the Hub pipeline tag is image-text-to-text, so the weights can take images and audio even though the card's example is text. max_position_embeddings is 131072. Safetensors total is 7,996,156,490 parameters; the card does not state a parameter count. No adapter_config.json. A separate repo EpistemeAI/Reasoning-Medical0.1-E4B-sft_lora exists; its card is Unsloth boilerplate and does not say those weights were merged here. The suggested prompt begins "You are a medical reasoning assistant for education and research." but the usage example puts the case in a user message and does not set a system role. BioSafeBench: 87.5/100 mean score and 85% automatic pass rate across 40 biological-safety evaluations. The introduction also says "Training was performed using the GRPO trainer"; the model-details table and Training Summary say supervised fine-tuning. No training script resolves that. Dataset-card papers were not read in full and do not appear in the model-name search.

evaluation_reported.text: mmlu_pro_biology exact_match 0.75 (5-shot); mmlu_proX_en_biology exact_match 0.75 (5-shot); medqa_4options acc 0.760 (0-shot) for EpistemeAI/Reasoning-Medical0.1-E4B-sft, with a comparison table of other models. BioSafeBench mean 87.5/100 and 85% automatic pass rate on 40 evaluations. MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, several MMLU medical subjects, and HealthBench-style evaluation are listed as suggested benchmarks without scores, except the biology and MedQA rows above.

discrepancies: Dataset and parent match. The card states both objectives: the introduction says "Training was performed using the GRPO trainer", while the model-details table says "Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT" and the Training Summary says "fine-tuned using supervised fine-tuning". The single objective field records sft. No training script shows whether both were used. Update scope is not stated.
